pos.personaBrief: Palmeiras 1993 cadenced and imposed itself with the ball, but his 2023 view accepts the long ball and speed of Edmundo and Edilson in transition; pragmatic possession.

pro.personaBrief: Diamond midfield with an articulator and fast forwards; he defends the chutao when the team cannot play out, so progression is mixed and pragmatic.

est.personaBrief: Zonal back four, defined diamond roles, Edmundo and Edilson as wide arrows, Evair dropping to articulate.

lar.personaBrief: Diamond midfield with two strikers, no classic wingers; central overload (Rincon, Alex, Ricardinho) was the base.

blo.personaBrief: No pressing evidence; zonal four with defensive balance suggests compact mid block rather than high press.

mar.personaBrief: Zonal marking with a back four at Palmeiras 1993 is documented.

pla.personaBrief: Built teams around available players (Alex, Rincon moved, shape tinkering at Corinthians and Santos); he says to assemble the team by what players offer.

res.personaBrief: A title winner, pragmatic and results-first, tinkering until the team won.

sis.personaBrief: Built around Alex and gave stars roles but expected duties; shapes system around talent while demanding order.

jog.personaBrief: Teams with technical playmakers (Alex, Ricardinho, Mazinho) but with volantes like Vampeta and Rincon in physical roles.

bas.personaBrief: Won with signings and veterans such as Zinho and Rincon, although Santos 2004 had Meninos da Vila.

lid.personaBrief: Commander and commanded: dining-hall clash with Marcelinho, who was cut from the game; authority first, though he backed Alex.
